# 996TT

> 996TT.net is David Keator's site about his 2004 Porsche 996 Turbo X50 (black, cabriolet): canyon drives and club runs with SoCal Drivers Club, car shows such as ünStock 2026 on the Huntington Beach pier, track days in Southern California, and a 26-modification garage build.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.996tt.net/): overview, recent drives and a timeline of track days
- [Drives](https://www.996tt.net/drives.html): ünStock 2026 (featured in the PCA Spotlight video), the Ortega canyon drive, a Cars & Coffee run, a GT3 RS at Speed Vegas, and the Porsche Experience Center Los Angeles
- [Willow Springs](https://www.996tt.net/willow-springs.html): track days at Willow Springs International Raceway and Streets of Willow with the Porsche Owners Club
- [Auto Club Speedway](https://www.996tt.net/auto-club-speedway.html): the California Festival of Speed and roval track days
- [Track Days](https://www.996tt.net/more-events.html): SoCal Drivers Club (2025) and Chuckwalla Valley Raceway (March 2023) with onboard video
- [The Build](https://www.996tt.net/build.html): 26 modifications including a GT3 gearset and RS differential, GT2 RS intercoolers, GIAC Stage 3, Bilstein PSS10 suspension, big brakes, a roll bar and race seats

## About

- Owner: David Keator (https://www.davidkeator.com/)
- Related site: DKOC Guitars, David's custom guitar workshop (https://www.dkocguitars.com/)
